assertions: Establishes the review range and reads repository instructions before judging the change
Prioritizes a small number of high-confidence structural findings with file-and-line evidence
Looks for a behaviour-preserving reframing that removes concepts or branches
Does not treat file size alone as proof of a defect
Does not edit code unless implementation was separately requested
States explicitly when no maintainability blockers are found
